Free SSL certificates from Let's Encrypt on every plan

Email is not included with any hosting plan; business email is a separate service

facts.fact: NVMe SSD storage on every plan

facts.fact: Customers manage files, databases, plugins, themes, staging and backups in the control panel; SSH and WP-CLI are not offered (claim wp-control-panel does not render; not usable)
Of 18 hosts whose renewal price HostingScale knows, 16 raise it at renewal (HostingScale, updated 30 July 2026)
Growth adds priority support; Pro adds semi-dedicated resources and performance tuning; Scale adds dedicated resources and senior experts
Extra Layer Security is included on Pro and Scale and a paid add-on on Starter and Growth
Prices show in USD, GBP, EUR, AED and INR; the currency follows the visitor's choice or location; the same plans and prices apply in every country
Above Scale: high-traffic and dedicated plans are scoped with the team, with no published price

Cloud web hosting shows the same four plans as every hosting page (Starter, Growth, Pro, Scale) through HostingPricing; the page calls them cloud hosting because they run on infrastructure from leading cloud providers

DronaHost owns no servers or data centers; plans run on infrastructure from leading cloud providers, with no fixed provider or location per plan; FAQ and answer copy may name AWS, Google Cloud and DigitalOcean in plain text with a line that the provider can vary (decision 80), never as logos
99.99% uptime SLA with service credits (claim uptime-sla); renders only when the claim renders
Server monitoring is included with every plan
Plans do not scale automatically; when a site outgrows its plan, the customer moves up to a larger plan. How a plan change is done and billed (proration) is not confirmed
